name: multi-file-refactor
prompt: Rename the exported function FetchRecord to LoadRecord throughout this Go module, including its doc comment and every call site. The package must still build and its tests must still pass.
notes: The same operation as single-file-edit, spread over four files. It separates a harness that greps for call sites from one that edits the file it happens to be looking at, and the test file is one of the call sites, so a partial rename fails to compile rather than failing silently.
